subproblem.title: Eventual compact-set mass bound from flat convergence (step 0(a))
subproblem.statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, P ∈ G(N,n), θ₀ > 0 and W_k (k ∈ ℕ) n-varifolds on B°_5(0) satisfying (H): ∫ f dW_k → θ₀ ∫ f dv(P) for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n), ℝ) with tsupport f ⊆ B°_5(0) × G(N,n). Let K be compact, O open with K ⊆ O ⊆ B°_5(0), and c ∈ [0,∞] with θ₀·H^n(P.plane ∩ O) < c (product in [0,∞], θ₀ read as ENNReal.ofReal θ₀). Then μ_{W_k}(K) < c for all sufficiently large k. Notation: H^n := μHE[n]; G(N,n) := Grassmannian N n; p_S := Grassmannian.project S (orthogonal projection onto S.plane); t_P(S) := ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap(projectionLinearMap S − projectionLinearMap P)‖ (operator norm of p_S − p_P); μ_W := W.weight; ‖δW‖ := variationMeasure W; v(T) := planeVarifoldMeasure T; B_ρ(y) := closedBall y ρ, B°_ρ(y) := ball y ρ; unitBallVolume n is the extended-real volume of the open unit ball of ℝ^n; ofReal := ENNReal.ofReal.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (θ₀ : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5)), 0 < θ₀ → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5 ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(W k).measure) atTop (𝓝 (θ₀ * ∫ z, f z ∂(planeVarifoldMeasure P)))) → ∀ (K O : Set (Euclidean N)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), IsCompact K → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → O ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5 → ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ * (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((P.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ O) < c → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, (W k).weight K < c
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 0(a) of the supplied proof of the parent theorem intcpt_flat_limit_integer_multiplicity (Urysohn function g with g = 1 on K and compact support in O; μ_k(K) ≤ ∫ g dμ_k → θ₀∫_{P.plane} g dH^n ≤ θ₀H^n(P.plane ∩ O)). Notation: G := Grassmannian N n (compact, Grassmannian.instCompactSpace); H^n := μHE[n]; unitBallVolume n is the extended-real volume of the open unit ball of EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) and ω := (unitBallVolume n).toReal; μ_V := V.weight = V.measure.map Prod.fst; B_ρ(y) := closedBall y ρ, B°_ρ(y) := ball y ρ; v(T) := planeVarifoldMeasure T = (H^n⌞T.plane).map (y ↦ (y,T)); p_S := Grassmannian.project S = Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap S; t_P(S) := ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap S − Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ (operator norm of p_S − p_P). (H) denotes the hypothesis ∫ f dW_k → θ₀ ∫ f dv(P) for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G, ℝ) with tsupport f ⊆ B°_5(0) × G.
1. Urysohn (exists_continuousMap_one_of_isCompact_subset_isOpen): there is a continuous g : ℝ^N → [0,1] with g = 1 on K, tsupport g compact and tsupport g ⊆ O.
2. A := H^n(P.plane ∩ O) is finite: otherwise θ₀·A = ∞ because θ₀ > 0, contradicting θ₀·A < c ≤ ∞.
3. tsupport g ⊆ O ⊆ B°_5(0), so the sibling weight_tendsto gives ∫ g dμ_k → θ₀ I with I := ∫_{P.plane} g dH^n.
4. I ≤ A (as reals): g ≤ 1_O pointwise (g ≤ 1, and g = 0 off tsupport g ⊆ O); 1_O is integrable on P.plane because (H^n⌞P.plane)(O) = A < ∞; so by monotonicity of the integral of nonnegative functions I ≤ ∫_{P.plane} 1_O dH^n = A.
5. Hence ofReal(θ₀ I) ≤ ofReal(θ₀ A) = ofReal(θ₀)·A < c (θ₀ ≥ 0, A finite).
6. By continuity of ofReal, ofReal(∫ g dμ_k) → ofReal(θ₀ I) < c, so ofReal(∫ g dμ_k) < c for all large k (Tendsto.eventually_lt_const).
7. For every k, μ_k(tsupport g) < ∞ (Varifold.weight_finite_on_compact: tsupport g is a compact subset of B°_5(0)); since |g| ≤ 1 and g vanishes off tsupport g, g is μ_k-integrable (Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded, integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset). Then μ_k(K) = ∫⁻ 1_K dμ_k ≤ ∫⁻ ofReal(g) dμ_k = ofReal(∫ g dμ_k), using 1_K ≤ ofReal ∘ g (g = 1 on K, g ≥ 0) and ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal.
8. By 6 and 7, μ_k(K) < c for all large k.

Implementation aid (optional; not part of the proof): a kernel-checked Lean proof of this exact statement following these steps is Submission.intcpt_fli_weight_compact_eventually_lt in the git-ignored file GMT/Scratch/FLI_Decomp.lean of the gmt-ch08 workspace (copy: /tmp/fli-decomp/FullCmp.lean), if still present.
proof_key_steps: Urysohn function g ∈ [0,1], g = 1 on K, compact support in O.
weight_tendsto: ∫ g dμ_k → θ₀∫_{P.plane} g dH^n ≤ θ₀A, and θ₀A < c.
μ_k(K) ≤ ofReal(∫ g dμ_k) by integrability on a compact subset of B°_5(0).
